values.label: Insulated delivery box

values.hint: Plastic-coated flyers go in the general waste bag.

values.label: Glass
values.hint: Bottles, jars, drinking glasses, window glass

conditions.question: Is there food or grease on it that rinsing will not remove?
conditions.help: Rinse it first if you can. Answer Yes only if it is still dirty after rinsing.

Heat-resistant, crystal, ceramic or window glass
values.hint: Includes coated or coloured glass products, lighting glass and pottery (사기·도자기).

conditions.question: Is the paper cup coated on both sides?

values.label: Yes
values.hint: Both the inside and the outside have a coating.

values.label: No

outcomes.label: Paper
outcomes.detail: Put it out with paper recycling.

outcomes.label: Drink cartons
outcomes.detail: Put it in the carton-only collection bin.

outcomes.label: Glass bottles
outcomes.detail: Put it out with glass bottles.

outcomes.label: Cans
outcomes.detail: Put it out with metal cans.

outcomes.label: Clear PET bottles
outcomes.detail: Put it out as a clear PET bottle, separate from other plastics.

outcomes.label: Plastics
outcomes.detail: Put it out with plastic containers.

outcomes.label: Plastic film
outcomes.detail: Put it out with plastic film and bags, inside a clear or semi-clear bag.

outcomes.label: Battery collection box
outcomes.detail: Put it in a battery collection box at a collection point.

outcomes.label: Fluorescent lamp collection box
outcomes.detail: Put it in your district's fluorescent lamp collection container.

outcomes.label: General waste bag (종량제봉투)
outcomes.detail: Put it in the general waste bag, called a 종량제봉투 (jongnyangje-bongtu). It is the official pay-as-you-throw bag: you pay for the bag, and the price depends on its size.

outcomes.label: Special sack for non-combustibles (특수규격마대)
outcomes.detail: Put it in a special sack for non-combustible waste, called a 특수규격마대 (teuksu-gyugyeok madae). You buy the sack. Large items can also go out as bulky waste (대형폐기물).

outcomes.label: Ask your district office
outcomes.detail: The guides this app uses do not cover this case. Ask your district office (구청) before you put it out.

rules.note: Take off any plastic coating, tape, staples and foil, then fold the box.
The Ministry's guide lists a pizza box as paper, but inner paper soiled with grease goes in the general waste bag.
A box with a foil or plastic lining that cannot be separated from the paper cannot be recycled as paper.
Keep it dry, flatten it, stack it and tie it into a bundle. Remove plastic covers and spiral bindings first.
Paper with food or dirt on it goes in the general waste bag. (Ministry FAQ, paper with dirt.)
A paper cup coated on both sides cannot be recycled as paper.
Empty it, rinse it with water and press it flat. Put cups in a bag or tie them together.
A cup with a lot of food or other residue on it goes in the general waste bag. (Ministry FAQ, paper cups.)
Empty it, rinse it and let it dry. Use the carton-only bin. If there is none, tie the cartons together and put them out beside the paper.
A carton with a lot of residue on it goes in the general waste bag. (Ministry FAQ, cartons.)
Thermal paper receipts cannot be recycled as paper.

Empty it and rinse it. If it is still dirty, wash it as clean as you can and put it out with glass anyway (moe-2018 FAQ p.23 (유리병 이물질)). Deposit bottles (soju, beer) can go back to a shop. Ordinary drinking glasses and beer mugs go with glass bottles too (moe-2018 FAQ p.22 (유리잔)).
Wrap the pieces in newspaper first. A small amount goes in the general waste bag. A large amount goes in a special sack for non-combustibles (특수규격마대) (seoul-2025 A1 3).
Heat-resistant, crystal, coated or coloured glass, window glass, lighting glass and ceramics go in a special sack (특수규격마대) or can be put out as bulky waste (대형폐기물).
Empty it and rinse it. If it is still dirty, wash it as clean as you can and put it out with cans anyway (moe-2018 FAQ p.23 (캔 이물질)). Remove plastic lids and anything else that is not metal.
Aluminium foil goes in the general waste bag.

Empty it, peel off the label, press it flat and close the cap. Put it out separately from other plastics. If it is still dirty, wash it as clean as you can and put it out as PET anyway (moe-2018 FAQ p.23 (페트병 이물질)).
Empty it and rinse it. Remove the label and any parts made of another material. If it is still dirty, wash it as clean as you can (moe-2018 FAQ p.23 (페트병 이물질)).
Empty it and rinse it. Remove the label and any parts made of another material.
Neither guide says what to do with a plastic container that still has food or grease on it after rinsing.

rules.note: Empty it, rinse it, and put it out inside a clear or semi-clear bag.
Film or wrap that cannot be cleaned, such as snack and noodle wrappers, goes in the general waste bag.
Empty it, rinse it and remove labels.
Styrofoam with food on it, or with dirt that is hard to remove, goes in the general waste bag.
Take the battery out of the device. Put it in a battery collection box at a collection point.
Put it in your district's fluorescent lamp collection container.
A small amount of a broken lamp goes in the general waste bag. A large amount goes in a special sack for non-combustibles (특수규격마대).
